title: taw.json — a TAW site's own settings
description: Site-owned, never synced. Mirrors TAW\Update\Policy (PolicyTest keeps them in sync). Every setting is optional; leave one out for its default.

update.description: What an update changes on its own: bin/taw update follows every setting; the migrations (composer update, bin/taw upgrade) follow scaffold and docs. The weekly framework-sync workflow doesn't read this yet.

core.description: patch: bug-fix releases only. minor (default): every 1.x release. pinned:<version>: exactly that version.

scaffold.description: auto (default): framework-owned files (Tier 1) are replaced, and unedited vite.config.js/phpstan.neon load taw/core's base. off: reported, not written.

manifests.description: add+bump (default): composer.json/package.json get what a new taw/core needs; nothing is removed. off: reported only.

docs.description: framework-sections (default): the framework's part of the agent docs comes from taw/core; unedited AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/Copilot/Windsurf copies become short files that import or point to it, edited ones are left for a person. off: updates leave the agent docs alone.

checks.description: What must pass before the update is delivered.

deliver.description: pr (default): a pull request for you to merge. pr+merge: merged when every check passes (merging deploys production). branch: committed on a branch, nothing pushed.
